claims.statement: The ministry dates this period to approximately 747 BCE–332 BCE.
Kushite, Saite and Persian phases form part of this broad period of changing rule.

evidence.note: Approximate period boundaries follow the Egyptian ministry. Other entries use museum chronologies, so boundaries can overlap or leave small gaps; these are dating differences, not evidence that nothing happened. The source heading begins in 747 BCE, while its prose also uses the narrower Saite starting point of 664 BCE.
